population: Existing consumed 128 snapshots; fresh-scene model results excluded from selection
ranking: Most cases meeting the unchanged 1e-6 relative equation-residual target at four passes
Smallest worst relative equation residual at four passes
Smallest median isolated CPU inference time at four passes
selection: Best new arm is selected for independent diagnostic qualification, even if it fails the desired target. Selection does not imply improvement or deployment promotion.
desired_result: All 128 snapshots qualify at four passes; all 128 still qualify at eight passes; independently simulated trajectories retain physical qualification.
baseline: C53 at eight passes, with C53/C55 at 1/2/4/8 passes retained for context
duration: Eight independent setups, 512 steps each, 15 native warm-up steps, dt=1/60 s. Stop on failed physical qualification. Extend only a qualified candidate.
fresh_simulation_policy: Run selected arm at four and eight passes and C53 at eight passes, using identical frozen scenes. No fitting or reselection from fresh-scene results.
